## Import data

```{r read data}
data <- read.delim(here::here("data", "OLINK", "quant.xls"), sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

clin <- read_excel("/home/gbonaz/data/DCM_snRNAseq/data/Baza_dla_Gino_AP.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("^Unnamed")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Sample %in% c("PK211", "P11")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    LVEF_percent = as.numeric(LVEF_percent),
    LVID_mm = as.numeric(LVID_mm),
    LVEDD_mm = as.numeric(LVEDD_mm),
    RVOT_mm = as.numeric(RVOT_mm),
    TAPSE_mm = as.numeric(TAPSE_mm),
    RVIT_mm = as.numeric(RVIT_mm),
    RAA_cm2 = as.numeric(RAA_cm2),
    RVS_cm.s = as.numeric(RVS_cm.s),
    RVSP_mmHg = as.numeric(RVSP_mmHg),
    sPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(sPAP_mmHg),
    mPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    PCW_mmHg = as.numeric(PCW_mmHg),
    PVR_WU = as.numeric(PVR_WU),
    TPG_mmHg = as.numeric(TPG_mmHg),
    CO_l.min = as.numeric(CO_l.min),
    TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg
  )

meta <-  read_excel(here::here("data", "OLINK", "Samples_RV_Olink.xlsx"))
meta <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(Olink == "Yes", !Sample %in% c("PK211", "P11"))
  
rownames(data) <- sub("_.*", "", data$SampleID)
data <- data[, -1]


keep <- intersect(colnames(data), meta$Sample)
data <- data[, keep, drop = FALSE]
dim(data)
```

## Heatmaps, PCA

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10.8}
barcodes <- colnames(data)

grp <- meta$Group[match(barcodes, meta$Sample)]
btc <- meta$Batch[match(barcodes, meta$Sample)]
btc <- factor(btc, levels = c("1","2"))
bca <- meta$BCA_mg_ml[match(barcodes, meta$Sample)]
bca <- as.numeric(bca)

# --- colors ---
cols_group <- c("HC"="#004C8C", "DCM"="#A63A2A")
cols_batch <- c("1"="orange", "2"="purple")

# BCA greyscale (light -> dark)
bca_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("grey80", "grey20"))(100)
bca_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(min(bca, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(bca, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(bca, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c(bca_cols[1], bca_cols[50], bca_cols[100])
)

# --- z-score per protein (row) ---
matz <- t(scale(t(data)))
matz[is.nan(matz)] <- 0

# heatmap colors
hm_cols <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

# column annotations
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = grp,
  Batch = btc,
  BCA_mg_ml = bca,
  col = list(
    Group = cols_group,
    Batch = cols_batch,
    BCA_mg_ml = bca_col_fun
  ),
  na_col = "#E5E7EB",
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Group"),
    Batch = list(title = "Batch"),
    BCA_mg_ml = list(title = "BCA (mg/mL)")
  )
)

# --- draw (all proteins, no row names, default clustering, no group split) ---
Heatmap(
  matz,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = hm_cols,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  row_title = NULL,
  column_title = NULL
) |>
  draw(heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
```

```{r heatmap_top100var, fig.height=10.88, fig.width=10.8}
# --- pick top 100 variable proteins (rows) ---
vars <- apply(data, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
top100 <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:100]
mat_top <- as.matrix(data[top100, , drop = FALSE])

# --- z-score per protein (row) ---
matz <- t(scale(t(mat_top)))
matz[is.nan(matz)] <- 0

Heatmap(
  matz,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = hm_cols,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_row_names = TRUE,              # set FALSE if you want to hide protein names
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8.5),
  row_title = "Top 100 variable proteins",
  column_title = NULL
) |>
  draw(heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
```

```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=5.4}
pca <- prcomp(t(as.matrix(data)), scale. = TRUE)
pvar <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100

df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  Group = meta$Group[match(rownames(pca$x), meta$Sample)]
)

cols_group <- c("HC" = "#004C8C", "DCM" = "#A63A2A")

ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Group)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Group), type = "norm", level = 0.95,
               geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, color = NA) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_group) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_group) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pvar[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pvar[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
samples_to_remove_downstream <- c("PK69", "PK61", "PK63", "P11")

clin_dcm <- clin %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Group == "DCM",
    Sample %in% colnames(data),
    !Sample %in% samples_to_remove_downstream
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

data_dcm_analysis <- data[, clin_dcm$Sample, drop = FALSE]
data_dcm_analysis <- data_dcm_analysis[, clin_dcm$Sample, drop = FALSE]

meta_dcm <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(data_dcm_analysis)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    clin_dcm %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Group, Sex) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
    by = c("Sample", "Group")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Variance partitioning

```{r vp_z_all_group_batch, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=6.5}
# expression: proteins x samples
expr <- as.matrix(data)

# meta_pdata aligned to columns of expr
meta_p <- meta |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    clin %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Group, Sex) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
    by = c("Sample", "Group")
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr)) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

# variables for this model (Zurich: NO Origin in all-samples model)
vars <- c("Group", "Batch", "Sex", "BCA_mg_ml")
meta_p <- meta_p |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(Group),
    Batch = factor(Batch),
    Sex = factor(Sex)
  )

# keep complete cases for model variables
n_before <- nrow(meta_p)

meta_p <- meta_p[complete.cases(meta_p[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

n_after <- nrow(meta_p)
message("All: ", n_after, " / ", n_before, " samples used")

form <- ~ Group + Batch + Sex

vp <- fitExtractVarPartModel(expr, form, meta_p)
colnames(vp) <- gsub("`", "", colnames(vp))

# quick summaries
vp_mean <- sort(colMeans(vp), decreasing = TRUE)
df <- data.frame(variable = names(vp_mean), value = vp_mean)

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(variable, -value), y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction of variance explained",
       title = "All samples") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plotVarPart(vp) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r vp_z_all_group_bca, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=6.5}
# expression: proteins x samples
expr <- as.matrix(data)

# meta_pdata aligned to columns of expr
meta_p <- meta |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    clin %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Group, Sex) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
    by = c("Sample", "Group")
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr)) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

# variables for this model (now using BCA as the "technical" covariate)
vars <- c("Group", "Sex", "BCA_mg_ml")

meta_p <- meta_p |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(Group),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    BCA_mg_ml = as.numeric(BCA_mg_ml)
  )

# keep complete cases for model variables
n_before <- nrow(meta_p)

meta_p <- meta_p[complete.cases(meta_p[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

n_after <- nrow(meta_p)
message("All: ", n_after, " / ", n_before, " samples used")

# variance partitioning model (BCA is continuous)
form <- ~ Group + Sex + BCA_mg_ml

vp <- fitExtractVarPartModel(expr, form, meta_p)
colnames(vp) <- gsub("`", "", colnames(vp))

# quick summaries
vp_mean <- sort(colMeans(vp), decreasing = TRUE)
df <- data.frame(variable = names(vp_mean), value = vp_mean)

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(variable, -value), y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction of variance explained",
       title = "All samples") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plotVarPart(vp) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=6.5}
# expression: proteins x samples
expr <- as.matrix(data_dcm_analysis)

meta_21 <- meta_dcm %>%
  left_join(clin_dcm, by = c("Sample", "Group", "Sex")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(data_dcm_analysis))

# meta_pdata aligned to columns of expr
meta_p <- meta_21 |>
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr)) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

# variables for this model (now using BCA as the "technical" covariate)
vars <- c("BCA_mg_ml", "Age_years", "Sex", "mPAP_mmHg", "TAPSE_mm")

meta_p <- meta_p |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    BCA_mg_ml = as.numeric(BCA_mg_ml),
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    mPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    TAPSE_mm = as.numeric(TAPSE_mm)
  )

# keep complete cases for model variables
n_before <- nrow(meta_p)

meta_p <- meta_p[complete.cases(meta_p[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

n_after <- nrow(meta_p)
message("21: ", n_after, " / ", n_before, " samples used")

# variance partitioning model (BCA is continuous)
form <- ~ BCA_mg_ml + Age_years + Sex + mPAP_mmHg + TAPSE_mm

vp <- fitExtractVarPartModel(expr, form, meta_p)
colnames(vp) <- gsub("`", "", colnames(vp))

# quick summaries
vp_mean <- sort(colMeans(vp), decreasing = TRUE)
df <- data.frame(variable = names(vp_mean), value = vp_mean)

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(variable, -value), y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction of variance explained",
       title = "DCM cohort after exclusion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plotVarPart(vp) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Differential expression analysis

```{r de_group_zurich}
meta_21$TAPSE_sPAP <- meta_21$TAPSE_mm/meta_21$sPAP_mmHg
colnames(meta_21)
```

```{r de_mPAP_olink}
meta_de <- meta_21 %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(data_dcm_analysis)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_years   = as.numeric(Age_years),
    Sex         = factor(Sex),
    mPAP_mmHg   = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    BCA_mg_ml   = as.numeric(BCA_mg_ml)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

meta_de <- meta_de[complete.cases(meta_de[, c("Age_years", "Sex", "mPAP_mmHg", "BCA_mg_ml")]), , drop = FALSE]

expr_de <- as.matrix(data_dcm_analysis[, rownames(meta_de), drop = FALSE])

design <- model.matrix(~ mPAP_mmHg + Age_years + Sex + BCA_mg_ml, data = meta_de)
design[, "Age_years"] <- rescale(design[, "Age_years"])
design[, "mPAP_mmHg"] <- rescale(design[, "mPAP_mmHg"])
design[, "BCA_mg_ml"] <- rescale(design[, "BCA_mg_ml"])

fit <- lmFit(expr_de, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

coef_group <- grep("^mPAP_mmHg", colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]

DE_mpap_olink <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_group, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
DE_mpap_olink$Gene <- rownames(DE_mpap_olink)

DE_mpap_olink_signif <- DE_mpap_olink %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(P.Value)

write.csv(DE_mpap_olink,
          file = here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_Results_mPAP.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(DE_mpap_olink_signif,
          file = here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_Significant_mPAP.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
expr_all <- as.matrix(data_dcm_analysis)

clin_params <- c(
  "LVEF_percent","LVID_mm","LVEDD_mm","RVOT_mm",
  "TAPSE_mm","RVIT_mm","RAA_cm2","RVS_cm.s","RVSP_mmHg","sPAP_mmHg","mPAP_mmHg",
  "PCW_mmHg","PVR_WU","TPG_mmHg","CO_l.min","TAPSE_sPAP"
)

meta_de0 <- meta_21 %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_all)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    BCA_mg_ml = as.numeric(BCA_mg_ml),
    across(all_of(clin_params), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

DE_results_list_olink <- list()
DE_signif_list_olink  <- list()
volcano_olink <- list()
n_de_proteins_olink <- data.frame()

for (param in clin_params) {

  vars <- c(param, "Age_years", "Sex", "BCA_mg_ml")

  meta_de <- meta_de0
  meta_de <- meta_de[complete.cases(meta_de[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]

  expr_de <- expr_all[, rownames(meta_de), drop = FALSE]

  design <- model.matrix(stats::as.formula(paste0("~ ", param, " + Age_years + Sex + BCA_mg_ml")),
                         data = meta_de)

  design[, param]       <- scales::rescale(design[, param])
  design[, "Age_years"] <- scales::rescale(design[, "Age_years"])
  design[, "BCA_mg_ml"] <- scales::rescale(design[, "BCA_mg_ml"])

  fit <- lmFit(expr_de, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)

  coef_name <- grep(paste0("^", param, "$"), colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]

  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  tt$Gene <- rownames(tt)
  tt$parameter <- param
  tt$n_complete_samples <- nrow(meta_de)

  tt_signif <- tt %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(P.Value)

  DE_results_list_olink[[param]] <- tt
  DE_signif_list_olink[[param]]  <- tt_signif

  write.csv(tt,
            file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("DE_Results_", param, "_PK21.csv")),
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(tt_signif,
            file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("DE_Significant_", param, "_PK21.csv")),
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  
  n_de_proteins_olink_temp <- data.frame(metadata = param,
                                n_upregulated = sum(DE_signif_list_olink[[param]]$logFC > 0.5),
                                n_downregulated = sum(DE_signif_list_olink[[param]]$logFC < -0.5),
                                n_tot = nrow(DE_signif_list_olink[[param]])
                                )
  n_de_proteins_olink <- rbind(n_de_proteins_olink, n_de_proteins_olink_temp)
  
  keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(DE_results_list_olink[[param]]))
  names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(DE_results_list_olink[[param]]))
  keyvals[DE_results_list_olink[[param]]$logFC > 0.5 & DE_results_list_olink[[param]]$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#A63A2A"
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
  keyvals[DE_results_list_olink[[param]]$logFC < -0.5 & DE_results_list_olink[[param]]$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
  
  volcano_olink[[param]] <- EnhancedVolcano(DE_results_list_olink[[param]],
                  lab = DE_results_list_olink[[param]]$Gene,
                  x = "logFC",
                  y = "adj.P.Val",
                  labSize = 0,
                  titleLabSize = 16,
                  subtitleLabSize = 14,
                  axisLabSize = 12,
                  captionLabSize = 9,
                  pointSize = 0.5,
                  FCcutoff = 0.5,
                  pCutoff  = 0.1,
                  ylim = c(0, 3),
                  colCustom = keyvals,
                  colAlpha = 1,
                  drawConnectors = FALSE,
                  subtitle = NULL,
                  title = paste0(param, "\nn = ", nrow(meta_de))
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

saveRDS(DE_results_list_olink, here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_Results_all_params_PK211.rds"))
saveRDS(DE_signif_list_olink,  here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_Significant_all_params_PK21.rds"))
```

```{r cor_mpap_spap, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5.5}
df <- meta_21 %>%

ggplot(df, aes(x = mPAP_mmHg, y = sPAP_mmHg)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

           label = paste0("r = ", r_val, "\np = ", p_val),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
           size = 4) +
  labs(
    x = "mPAP (mmHg)",
    y = "sPAP (mmHg)"
  ) +
```

```{r heatmaps_all_params_olink, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
n_top <- 25

for (param in clin_params) {

  vars <- c(param, "Age_years", "Sex", "BCA_mg_ml")
  meta_de <- meta_de0
  meta_de <- meta_de[complete.cases(meta_de[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(meta_de) < 4) next

  tt <- DE_results_list_olink[[param]]
  if (is.null(tt) || nrow(tt) == 0) next

  top_up <- tt %>%
    dplyr::filter(logFC > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(t)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n_top)

  top_down <- tt %>%
    dplyr::filter(logFC < 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(t) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n_top)

  row_order_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    top_up %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(t)),
    top_down %>% dplyr::arrange(t)
  )
  row_order_tbl <- row_order_tbl[!duplicated(row_order_tbl$Gene), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row_order_tbl) == 0) next

  meta_ord <- meta_de %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[param]])

  mat <- expr_all[row_order_tbl$Gene, meta_ord$Sample, drop = FALSE]
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  mat_z[is.na(mat_z)] <- 0
  rownames(mat_z) <- row_order_tbl$Gene

  ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Parameter = meta_ord[[param]],
    Age = meta_ord$Age_years,
    Sex = meta_ord$Sex,
    BCA = meta_ord$BCA_mg_ml,
    col = list(
      Parameter = colorRamp2(
        c(min(meta_ord[[param]], na.rm = TRUE),
          median(meta_ord[[param]], na.rm = TRUE),
          max(meta_ord[[param]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        c("#DCEAF7", "#6AAED6", "#08306B")
      ),
      Age = colorRamp2(
        c(min(meta_ord$Age_years, na.rm = TRUE),
          median(meta_ord$Age_years, na.rm = TRUE),
          max(meta_ord$Age_years, na.rm = TRUE)),
        c("grey90", "grey60", "grey20")
      ),
      Sex = c("F" = "#A63A2A", "M" = "#004C8C"),
      BCA = colorRamp2(
        c(min(meta_ord$BCA_mg_ml, na.rm = TRUE),
          median(meta_ord$BCA_mg_ml, na.rm = TRUE),
          max(meta_ord$BCA_mg_ml, na.rm = TRUE)),
        c("grey90", "grey60", "grey20")
      )
    )
  )

  row_split <- c(
    rep(paste0("Positive association with ", param), nrow(top_up)),
    rep(paste0("Negative association with ", param), nrow(top_down))
  )
  row_split <- row_split[seq_len(nrow(mat_z))]

  ht <- Heatmap(
    mat_z,
    name = "Z-score",
    col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
    top_annotation = ha,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_split = row_split,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    column_title = paste0("Patients ordered by increasing ", param),
    row_title = "Proteins ranked by limma moderated t-statistic",
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7)
  )

  draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
}
```

```{r de_group_dcm_vs_hc}
meta_de <- meta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    clin %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Group, Sex, Age_years),
    by = c("Sample", "Group")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(data)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("HC", "DCM")),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    BCA_mg_ml = as.numeric(BCA_mg_ml)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

meta_de <- meta_de[complete.cases(meta_de[, c("Group", "Age_years", "Sex", "BCA_mg_ml")]), , drop = FALSE]

expr_de <- as.matrix(data[, rownames(meta_de), drop = FALSE])

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Group + Age_years + Sex + BCA_mg_ml, data = meta_de)
design[, "Age_years"] <- scales::rescale(design[, "Age_years"])
design[, "BCA_mg_ml"] <- scales::rescale(design[, "BCA_mg_ml"])
colnames(design) <- gsub("^Group", "", colnames(design))

fit <- lmFit(expr_de, design)

contr <- makeContrasts(DCMvsHC = DCM - HC, levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contr)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

DE_group_olink <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DCMvsHC", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
DE_group_olink$Gene <- rownames(DE_group_olink)

DE_group_olink_signif <- DE_group_olink %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(P.Value)

write.csv(DE_group_olink,
          file = here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_Results_Group_DCMvsHC.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(DE_group_olink_signif,
          file = here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_Significant_Group_DCMvsHC.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Binary clinical comparisons

```{r}
meta_bin <- clin_dcm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    BCA_mg_ml = as.numeric(meta_dcm$BCA_mg_ml[match(Sample, meta_dcm$Sample)]),
    mPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    TAPSE_mm = as.numeric(TAPSE_mm),
    sPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(sPAP_mmHg),
    TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg,
    mPAP_group = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(mPAP_mmHg) & mPAP_mmHg > 35  ~ "mPAP_hi",
      !is.na(mPAP_mmHg) & mPAP_mmHg <= 35 ~ "mPAP_lo",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TAPSE_sPAP_group = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(TAPSE_sPAP) & TAPSE_sPAP < 0.32  ~ "TAPSE_sPAP_low",
      !is.na(TAPSE_sPAP) & TAPSE_sPAP >= 0.32 ~ "TAPSE_sPAP_high",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

expr_bin <- data_dcm_analysis[, colnames(data_dcm_analysis) %in% meta_bin$Sample, drop = FALSE]

meta_bin <- meta_bin %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_bin)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr_bin <- expr_bin[, rownames(meta_bin), drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
keyvals[res_mPAP_group_olink$logFC < -0.5 & res_mPAP_group_olink$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
```

```{r}
fit <- eBayes(fit)

res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink$Gene <- rownames(res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink)
signif_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink <- res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(P.Value)

keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink))
names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink))
keyvals[res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink$logFC > 0.5 & res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#A63A2A"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
keyvals[res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink$logFC < -0.5 & res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"

volcano_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink <- EnhancedVolcano(
  res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink,
  lab = res_TAPSEsPAP_group_olink$Gene,
  x = "logFC",
  y = "adj.P.Val",
  labSize = 0,
  titleLabSize = 16,
  subtitleLabSize = 14,
  axisLabSize = 12,
  captionLabSize = 9,
  pointSize = 0.5,
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  pCutoff = 0.1,
  ylim = c(0, 3),
  colCustom = keyvals,
  colAlpha = 1,
  drawConnectors = FALSE,
  subtitle = NULL,
  title = paste0("TAPSE/sPAP < 0.32 vs >= 0.32\n", "n = ", nrow(meta_de))
) + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
data_sn <- subset(DCM_RV, mPAP_mmHg > 0 & Sample %in% clin_dcm$Sample)
```

```{r DE_mPAP}
sample_order <- colnames(pseudocounts_mPAP)

metadata_mPAP <- meta_21 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% sample_order) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(sample_order, Sample)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mPAP_mmHg), !is.na(Age_years))

pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[, metadata_mPAP$Sample]
sample_order <- colnames(pseudocounts_mPAP)
stopifnot(all(metadata_mPAP$Sample == sample_order))

design <- model.matrix(~ metadata_mPAP[["mPAP_mmHg"]] + metadata_mPAP[["Age_years"]])
colnames(design)[2] <- "mPAP_mmHg"
colnames(design)[3] <- "Age_years"
design[,"mPAP_mmHg"] <- rescale(design[,"mPAP_mmHg"])
design[,"Age_years"] <- rescale(design[,"Age_years"])

metadata_mPAP$Sample == pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$sample

pseudocounts_mPAP <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_mPAP)
pseudocounts_mPAP <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_mPAP, design)
  
fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_mPAP, design, robust=TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)
  
results_mPAP_olink_rna <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
results_mPAP_olink_rna <- merge(results_mPAP_olink_rna, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
results_mPAP_olink_rna$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_mPAP_olink_rna$logFC > 0.5 & results_mPAP_olink_rna$FDR < 0.1, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_mPAP_olink_rna$logFC < -0.5 & results_mPAP_olink_rna$FDR < 0.1, "Decreased",
           "Not significant"
           )
)

signif_mPAP_olink_rna <- results_mPAP_olink_rna %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_mPAP_olink_rna, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_mPAP.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)
write.csv(signif_mPAP_olink_rna, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_mPAP.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)
```

```{r cor_mpap_logfc, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5.5}
df <- dplyr::inner_join(
  results_mPAP_olink_rna %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(Gene = gene, logFC_results = logFC),
  DE_results_list_olink[["mPAP_mmHg"]] %>% dplyr::select(Gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(logFC_DE = logFC),
  by = "Gene"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(logFC_results), is.finite(logFC_DE))

# correlation test
ct <- cor.test(df$logFC_results, df$logFC_DE, method = "pearson")

r_val <- round(unname(ct$estimate), 2)
p_val <- signif(ct$p.value, 2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC_results, y = logFC_DE)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("r = ", r_val, "\np = ", p_val, "\nn = ", nrow(df)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "logFC (results_mPAP_olink_rna)",
    y = "logFC (DE_results_list_olink[['mPAP_mmHg']])"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r reorder_GO_by_pvalue}
reorder_GO_by_pvalue <- function(enrichGO_result) {
  go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
  go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(go_results$p.adjust), ]
  enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
  return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

```{r classify_terms}
classify_terms <- function(df) {
  df$sign <- ifelse(df$NES > 0, "activated", "suppressed")
  return(df)
}
```

## GSEA

```{r}
ranked_genes <- DE_results_list_olink[["mPAP_mmHg"]]
ranked_genes$metric <- ranked_genes$logFC * -log10(ranked_genes$P.Value)

entrezid <- bitr(
  ranked_genes$Gene,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
  drop = TRUE
)

ranked_genes <- merge(ranked_genes, entrezid, by.x = "Gene", by.y = "SYMBOL")
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[!duplicated(ranked_genes$ENTREZID), ]

genelist <- ranked_genes$metric
names(genelist) <- ranked_genes$ENTREZID
genelist <- genelist[order(genelist, decreasing = TRUE)]

GSEA_all <- gseGO(
  geneList = genelist,
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont = "ALL",
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  nPermSimple = 10000,
  minGSSize = 10,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
  eps = 0
)

GSEA_all <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(GSEA_all)
```

```{r GSEA_Cardiomyocytes, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
GSEA_simplified <- clusterProfiler::simplify(
  GSEA_all,
  cutoff = 0.75,
  by = "p.adjust",
  select_fun = min,
  measure = "Wang",
  semData = NULL
)

GSEA_simplified <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(GSEA_simplified)

dotplot(GSEA_simplified, showCategory = 8, split=".sign", title = paste0("Cardiomyocytes", "\nGO Enrichment Analysis", "\nmPAP-associated genes"), 
        label_format = 35, font.size = 15) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text( face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)) +
  facet_grid(.~.sign)
```

```{r GSEA_Cardiomyocytes_emapplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
GSEA_simplified@result <- classify_terms(GSEA_simplified@result)

activated_terms <- subset(GSEA_simplified@result, sign == "activated")
suppressed_terms <- subset(GSEA_simplified@result, sign == "suppressed")

GSEA_activated <- GSEA_simplified
GSEA_activated@result <- activated_terms
GSEA_activated <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_activated)

p1 <- emapplot(GSEA_activated, showCategory = 100, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.15) +
  ggtitle("Activated Terms") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))


combined_plot <- p1 
print(combined_plot)
rm(GSEA_simplified, activated_terms, suppressed_terms, GSEA_activated, GSEA_suppressed, p1, p2)
```
